question: What is the short title of Act No. XXXVIII of 2026 that repeals the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016?
expected_answer: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026.

question: Which specific provision of the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016 is excluded from repeal by the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026?
expected_answer: Sub-section (1) of section 7 is excepted from repeal.

question: According to the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026, when does the Act come into force?
expected_answer: It shall come into force at once.

question: Under the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2026, what is the first thing point with regards to use of mobile
expected_answer: A person shall not drive a motor cycle or motor vehicle if, he is using a hand-held mobile telephone or a device which performs an interactive communication function of transmitting and receiving data, fire, ambulance or other emergency service.

question: Under the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2026, under what circumstance is a driver not guilty of using a mobile telephone while driving in Islamabad Capital Territory?
expected_answer: A person is not guilty if they are using the mobile telephone or device to call the police, fire, ambulance, or other emergency service.

question: What is the territorial extent of the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. XXXII of 2026)?
expected_answer: It applies to the extent of Islamabad Capital Territory.

question: What is the revised penalty amount under the Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) (Amendment) Act, 2026 for unauthorized use in section 3?
expected_answer: The penalty is increased from five hundred rupees to fifty thousand rupees.

question: Which original 1957 statute is amended by the Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) (Amendment) Act, 2026?
expected_answer: The Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) Act, 1957 (XXVIII of 1957).

question: When did the Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) (Amendment) Act, 2026 receive the assent of the President?
expected_answer: It received the assent of the President on the 7th April, 2026.
